directAnswer.en: This is indoor mortar or plaster spraying. It is not a trailer-pump pour. The outlet pressure on this sprayer is 8 MPa. Do not borrow a trailer pump's pressure cell. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists Hydraulic Concrete Spraying Machine at 380 V, all-copper dual motors 7.5/9 kW, 5 m³/h, 8 MPa, 100 m horizontal / 50 m vertical, hose 38/51 mm, particle ≤8 mm, sand-cement ratio ≤1:3, 1500 × 700 × 1100 mm and 295 kg. Do not move the same condition onto Electric 20, which prints 22 kW, 8–10 m³/h, 10 MPa, 120 m horizontal / 40 m vertical, pipe 80 mm, aggregate 1–2 cm, hopper 0.25 m³, 2800 × 1300 × 1500 mm and 900 kg. The photograph is a working-condition reference from a public article about this kind of work. It is not a Pinjin contract record. This page names no project, no country job, no price and no daily volume.

heading.en: What the indoor spray has to match

body.en: This is indoor mortar or plaster spraying. It is not a trailer-pump pour. The outlet pressure on this sprayer is 8 MPa. Do not borrow a trailer pump's pressure cell. The published Hydraulic Concrete Spraying Machine row is 380 V, all-copper dual motors 7.5/9 kW, 5 m³/h, 8 MPa, 100 m horizontal / 50 m vertical, hose 38/51 mm, particle ≤8 mm, sand-cement ratio ≤1:3, 1500 × 700 × 1100 mm and 295 kg.
